summary: Completed end-to-end frontend Playwright testing for Cynos eCommerce storefront + admin panel. 71/73 checks passed. Full user journeys verified: Home -> Shop -> ProductDetail -> AddToCart -> CartDrawer -> Checkout (with CYNOS10 discount) -> OrderSuccess. Admin login + dashboard (stats, orders, products, add-product dialog) working. Mobile sticky bar and exit intent popup (copy CYNOS10) working. Backend was pre-validated (22 pytest passed) and skipped per request.

ui_bugs.issue: Quantity +/- buttons lack data-testid attributes (qty-plus/qty-minus). Functionality works (visible in UI) but harder to automate. Add aria-labels also already present.

issues: Request spec says 'bestsellers grid (8 cards)' but /api/products/bestsellers returns only 7 products (Static Mono Tee is not flagged is_bestseller=true). Minor seed-data discrepancy. Either mark Static Mono Tee as bestseller or update spec.

action_items: (LOW) Add data-testid='qty-plus' and 'qty-minus' to CartDrawer.jsx quantity increment/decrement buttons (currently only aria-labels).
(LOW) If spec requires 8 bestsellers on home, set is_bestseller=true for 'Static Mono Tee' in the seed data (backend/seed). Current state shows 7 cards which is still a clean grid.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin product rows do not have a generic data-testid='product-row-{slug}'; only edit-{slug} and delete-{slug} exist. Not blocking but worth adding for future testing.
Products-table renders correctly with 8 products; admin-stats shows Orders/Pending/Products/Revenue tiles correctly.
Checkout CYNOS10 discount logic works: subtotal reduced from ₹599 to ₹539 (~10% off) and COD selected; redirect to /order/{uuid} is clean.
Exit intent popup uses sessionStorage 'cynos_exit_seen_v1' correctly, responds to both mouseleave top-edge and is visually consistent with brand.
Sticky mobile bar correctly hidden on desktop, visible on 390px viewport with sticky-buy-now-btn.
Countdown timer, stock urgency ('Only X left'), size-guide dialog and FAQ accordion all functioning on /product/onyx-oversized-tee.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Placed 1 mock order (COD) using CYNOS10 during test; admin dashboard counted it (Orders=4).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical happy-path flows (storefront, cart, checkout, order success, admin login, admin CRUD dialog open) passed. 2 minor observations only: (a) CartDrawer qty buttons missing data-testid, (b) bestsellers API returns 7 items (spec asked 8). Full-stack app is production-ready for user demo. No backend retest needed.
